cues: On a slope, resolve along the plane and perpendicular to it.
A twenty kilogram block on a smooth thirty degree slope: its weight, two hundred newtons, splits into mg sin alpha down the slope and mg cos alpha into it.
So holding it needs a hundred newtons up the slope, and the plane pushes back with a hundred root three.
